message: a model produced a non-finite derivative (NaN or inf) in the equation of {unknown}, with respect to unknown #{column}
description: A model's contribution is finite here, but its derivative is not, so the solver cannot take a Newton step. This usually means a function used at a point where it is not differentiable, such as `sqrt(x)` or `pow(x, 0.5)` at x = 0.
actions: Look at the device(s) contributing to this unknown.
Keep the argument away from the point, e.g. `sqrt(x + 1e-12)`, or start from a better point with `.nodeset`.
